===Status of Pull Request on Ledger===
A pull request can only be made open once it is ready for review and merge by the Ledger team, which is when all milestones of this project are complete. This we have learned from our past and continous working experience with Ledger. Hence we had carefully planned the milestones of this proposals and submited SOM with DRAFT Pull Request specifically mentioned.
You can see the Final milestone on this project, which states finalising pull request, and successfully merged into Ledger Live repo.

===Some pull requests closed and reopened===
When working with a team from outside of an organization, we fork the repository, write code and create a pull request. The original team and repository will have automated checks implemented to review PR, which only execute of the pull request is made by the intenal team.
So to achieve that, many times, Ledger team will close the pull request created by us (external team), copy the branch and re-create the pull request by themselves, which allows them to execute tests and github checks.
